title: Senior Software Engineer, Devices - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.** 



  

 About JumpCloud®
   


 JumpCloud® is the AI\-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.
 


  


  
 


  

**JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.** 
  





  





  


 As we continue to grow JumpCloud internationally, we are hiring software engineers to expand our product. You’ll have the opportunity to play a key role in the success and development of our engineering teams in addition to growing your own career.
 


  


  
 


  


**About the Role:** 



  


 In this role, you will specifically work on the Device Management (MDM / Endpoint Management) vertical at JumpCloud, the role shifts focus from broad cloud microservices to deeply understanding operating system internals (macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android) and how they communicate with the cloud.
 


  


 In the Device Management vertical, you will build the software that allows IT administrators to remotely configure, patch, secure, and monitor thousands of endpoints from a single pane of glass. You will work on cross\-OS device management engines, mobile device management / Declarative Device Management(MDM/DDM) telemetry, custom system agents, and zero\-touch enrollment pipelines. This role balances local client\-side programming (interacting with the OS) and building high\-availability cloud APIs.
 


  


  
 


  






  




**What you’ll be doing:** 
  
* Primarily working with Go and Node.js for cross\-platform applications on Windows, macOS, and Linux
  
* Gaining or utilizing expertise in areas like Windows services, kernels, Event Loggers, Mac Launch daemons, and macOS internals
  
* Collaborating with architects, UX designers, and DevOps to ensure our systems are highly available, scalable, and deliver exceptional user experiences
  
* Working within a Scrum framework to drive agile development
  
* Learning and working with mTLS protocols and related security concepts. Prior experience in these areas is a plus
  
* Using OAuth/OIDC flows for secure user authentication and service access
  
* Writing Unit test cases, Functional test cases, acceptance tests along with automating these test cases
  
* Contributing to the future of our Device Management services by participating in strategic planning and scoping sessions with product managers
  
* Embodying our core values: building strong connections, thinking big, and striving to improve by 1% every day
  

  



  




**We’re looking for:** 
  
* 7\-10 years experience developing MAC, Windows, or  Linux applications (including integration with third\-party applications) in any modern language (Python, Java) or Golang. Experience in one of them is a must
  
* Experience using one of the public cloud providers (AWS, GCP or Azure) with CI/CD pipelines (preferably Github Action) to build, test and deploy. Knowledge of containerization technologies and orchestration with Kubernetes
  
* Strong hands\-on experience in backend software or full stack development is a must
  
* Working knowledge of Swift, C Sharp, C\+\+ would be an added advantage
  
* Working knowledge on device MDM would be an added advantage
  
* Willingness to mentor junior members of the team
  
* Bonus points if you have experience with Services, event logger, Kernel in Windows OS and/or Launch demon, app hosting in Mac
  

  






  




  


**Where you’ll be working/Location:** 



  



 JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
 



  


  
 


  


**You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.** 



  


  
 


  



 Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on\-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.
 



  


  
 


  


**Language:** 



  



 JumpCloud has teams in 15\+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.
 



  


  
 


  


**Why JumpCloud?** 

  
 



  



 If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS\-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  
 



  



  
 



  



 One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." \- Rajat Bhargava, CEO
 



  



  
 



  



 Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud.  Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   
 



  



  
 



  



 JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
 



  


  
 


  



**Scam Notice:** 




  



 Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
 



  


  
 


  



 All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice" 
 



  



  
 



  



 \#BI\-Remote
 



  


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

description:
Senior Full Stack Developer — AI\-Forward Development (.NET \& Angular)
 



  





 Saisystems Health is hiring an AI\-forward Full Stack Developer with 5\+ years of .NET and Angular experience and a US healthcare background to build and modernise ECM, our enterprise claims management platform
 



  





  





 About the role
 



  





 This is a hands\-on full stack role where AI\-assisted engineering is part of the job, not an optional extra. You will own tickets end to end — from design conversation through testing to production support — using AI coding assistants and agents to deliver faster while holding the quality and compliance bar of a regulated healthcare product.
 



  





**The product.** 
 ECM manages the full claim lifecycle for US healthcare provider organisations: patient and encounter capture, coding and charge entry, eligibility, a configurable business\-rules engine, clearinghouse claim transmission, ERA/835 payment posting, denial and AR work queues, patient statements, credentialing and executive reporting.
 



  





**The engineering problem.** 
 ECM is a mature, high\-volume, multi\-tenant SaaS platform with tens of millions of claim and transaction rows, external BI consumers on the same database, and scheduled automation running alongside the API. The work mixes new feature delivery with deliberate modernisation — performance, observability, test coverage, security hardening and technical\-debt reduction — in a system that cannot stop running.
 



  





**Why AI\-forward.** 
 We use AI across the engineering lifecycle and want engineers who already work this way: using agents and assistants to understand a large codebase, scaffold and refactor code, generate tests, review SQL and document changes — and who can explain every line they commit.
 



  





 Key responsibilities
 



 Front end (Angular)
 


* Build and enhance Angular screens — data grids, forms, multi\-step claim and payment workflows, filters, dashboards and exports — that stay usable on large result sets.
* Work within a large existing codebase using NgRx state management, RxJS and component\-driven design, refactoring incrementally rather than rewriting.
* Implement role\-driven UI that respects access control and minimum\-necessary display of sensitive data.



  





 Back end (.NET) and database
 


* Implement ASP.NET Core Web API endpoints and service\-layer logic (controller → interface → service) over stored procedures.
* Write and tune T\-SQL procedures, views and queries against tables with tens of millions of rows; design indexes and read execution plans.
* Reason about locking and concurrency against simultaneous BI reads and scheduled background jobs.
* Build and maintain healthcare integrations: inbound and outbound X12 EDI (837, 835, 277CA, 999\), clearinghouse SFTP exchange, ERA auto\-posting and payer interfaces.



  





 AI\-forward development
 


* Use AI coding assistants and agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex or similar) daily for codebase exploration, scaffolding, refactoring, unit\-test generation, SQL and code review, debugging and documentation.
* Treat all AI output as a draft: review, test and understand it before committing; apply extra scrutiny to AI\-assisted changes to stored procedures and production data paths.
* Identify and prototype practical AI use cases in the product and the development workflow — for example, test\-case design, requirement clarification and release notes — within approved, compliant tooling.
* Share prompts, workflows and lessons learned so the whole team gets faster.



  





 Quality, operations and compliance
 


* Diagnose production issues using Application Insights, logs and Query Store, and fix root causes.
* Write unit tests for new logic (xUnit, Moq, Jasmine/Karma) and partner with QA on regression coverage.
* Participate in code review as author and reviewer, and assess pre\-merge impact across the develop → QA → UAT → staging → production pipeline.
* Follow HIPAA and secure\-by\-default practices: no PHI in logs, tickets, screenshots or AI tools; secrets in Key Vault; least\-privilege access.
* Contribute to performance, quality and technical\-debt work alongside feature delivery.



  





 Collaboration
 



  




* Work from written requirements with US\-based product and business stakeholders, ask clarifying questions and give realistic estimates.
* Write clear design notes, PR descriptions and status updates that support asynchronous, cross\-time\-zone work.



  





 Required qualifications
 



  





 Experience
 


* 5\+ years of professional full stack development with .NET and Angular in production systems.
* 2\+ years working on US healthcare software — revenue cycle management, medical billing, claims, practice management, EHR or payer systems.



  





 .NET and database
 


* Strong C\# and ASP.NET Core Web API (.NET 6 or later); comfortable with Entity Framework Core and/or Dapper.
* Working SQL Server / T\-SQL: can write a non\-trivial stored procedure, read a query plan and explain why a query is slow.



  





 Angular
 


* Strong Angular (12\+) with TypeScript, RxJS and component\-driven design; able to work in a large existing codebase without rewriting it.



  





 AI\-forward engineering
 


* Demonstrated daily use of at least one AI development platform — Claude / Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT / Codex, Cursor or similar — for code generation, refactoring, test writing, debugging and documentation.
* Effective prompting and context management on a large, unfamiliar codebase, not just generic snippets.
* Verification discipline: can explain every line committed, and can show examples of catching and correcting flawed AI output.



  





 Healthcare domain
 


* Working knowledge of the claim lifecycle: charge entry, claim submission, adjudication, remittance, denials and AR follow\-up.
* Familiarity with HIPAA X12 transactions (837, 835, 277CA, 999\) and CMS\-1500 / UB\-04 claim formats.
* Understanding of HIPAA Privacy and Security Rule obligations and how they shape logging, access control and data handling.



  





 Engineering practice
 


* Git, pull\-request workflow and CI/CD (Azure DevOps or similar).
* Ability to work from written requirements, ask good clarifying questions and give realistic estimates.
* Willing to work from the Pune office full time.



  





 Preferred qualifications
 


* Experience with agentic AI workflows (for example, Claude Code or Copilot agents) for multi\-file changes, test generation or code migration.
* Experience integrating LLM APIs (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenAI) into .NET applications — prompt design, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), structured output and evaluation — within HIPAA\-compliant boundaries.
* Exposure to AI use cases in RCM such as denial prediction, coding assistance, document extraction or claim scrubbing.
* Microsoft Azure services: App Service, WebJobs, Blob Storage, Key Vault, Service Bus, Redis, Application Insights, Entra ID.
* NgRx or another Redux\-style state library; SignalR or other real\-time patterns.
* EDI tooling such as EdiFabric; SFTP and clearinghouse integrations.
* xUnit / NUnit / Jasmine\-Karma testing experience.
* Reporting or BI exposure (Power BI, SSRS).
* Certifications (any of): Microsoft Azure Developer Associate (AZ\-204\), Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI\-102\), or a healthcare credential such as AAPC or HFMA coursework.



  





**Education:** 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field — or equivalent demonstrable professional experience. What you have built and shipped counts more than the credential.
 



  





 Core competencies and success measures
 



  





 Ways of working
 


* **Evidence over assertion** 
 — claims about performance or impact are backed by a measurement or a source reference.
* **Production respect** 
 — the system handles live claims and money; changes are weighed for their effect on real data before merge.
* **Clear written communication** 
 — design notes, PR descriptions and status that someone outside your head can follow.
* **Cross\-time\-zone collaboration** 
 — close work with US\-based product and business stakeholders; asynchronous clarity matters as much as meetings.
* **Continuous learning** 
 — keeping current with AI tooling as it changes how this work is done.



  





 Compliance, security and responsible AI use
 



  




* ECM processes Protected Health Information (PHI). All engineers complete HIPAA training and are bound by Saisystems Health security and confidentiality policies.
* No PHI, patient data, credentials, production connection strings or confidential business data is ever entered into an external or unapproved AI tool.
* AI is an accelerator, not a substitute for engineering judgement; accountability for correctness stays with the engineer.
* AI\-generated code is reviewed to the same standard as hand\-written code, with added scrutiny for stored procedures and production data paths.
* Secure\-by\-default habits: no PHI in logs, tickets, screenshots or non\-production data; least\-privilege access; secrets in Key Vault, never in source.
* Design decisions account for audit, access control and data\-retention requirements of a regulated product.
* Employment is subject to a background check and a signed confidentiality agreement.



  





**Equal opportunity:** 
 Saisystems Health is an equal opportunity employer.

 This Role deals with in\-house software development for InfoSec groups (primarily, but not exclusively, for Cyber Operations personnel). Our services are currently engaged by the JSOC, IAM, Insider Risk, Digitial Risk, Cyber Threat Intel, and Advanced Threat Response teams, among others. The team\-member will partner with members of cyber operations, information security and the larger business to design, develop, test, and deploy strong automation use\-cases. * Partner with technology leaders in adherence to technology strategy and roadmap.
* Skillfully gather and analyze requirements from requesting parties and stakeholders.
* Design, develop, and release new use cases to maximize the benefits and efficiencies from a SOAR platform.
* Develop automations using no\-code, low\-code, and traditional code approaches, in that order.

* Intimate familiarity with the Agile Manifesto preferred.

Our hybrid work model enables teams to collaborate across regions while staying connected to the communities where they live and work. As a certified B Corporation, we meet rigorous standards of social and environmental performance, transparency, and accountability, reflecting our commitment to creating lasting value for our customers, our people, and the planet.
 



  





**People First. Technology Forward.**

 As we continue to embed AI into how we work, we do so thoughtfully, enhancing human potential, supporting better decision\-making, and prioritizing appropriate oversight, privacy, and fairness.
 



 At Assent, we value your privacy and are committed to maintaining transparency in how we handle your personal information. As part of our talent acquisition and management processes, we may use AI technologies to support activities such as resume screening, candidate communication, and talent analytics.
 



  





**Job Description** 




**Position Summary** 




 Assent is building a governed agentic AI platform that takes use cases from business idea through to production — deployed as governed services accessible across the company. You’ll work directly with business stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Enterprise Systems, and other functions to identify high\-impact opportunities, design and build the agents that solve them, and ship them into a governed catalog where they become the new baseline for the rest of the organization.
 



 This is not a classical ML role and not a traditional software engineering role. You’ll spend your time designing agent loops, orchestrating tools and sub\-agents, building RAG pipelines grounded in real enterprise data, and working with non\-technical stakeholders to translate a business problem into a production\-ready agentic solution — with observability, cost control, and governance built in from day one.

* Build evaluation harnesses and observability into every agent you ship: accuracy, hallucination rate, latency, and cost, with monitoring that holds up in production.
* Take solutions from proof\-of\-concept to production deployment, working within established patterns for authentication, cost metering, and logging.
* Contribute reusable patterns back into a shared library so that what you build for one team becomes accessible to the next — every solution should raise the floor for the whole organization.
* Work closely with the platform and integration team to ensure what you build deploys cleanly into the governed catalog rather than living as a standalone one\-off.



  





**Qualifications** 




**Your Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** 




**We strongly value your talent, energy and passion. It will also be valuable to Assent if you have the following qualifications** 




**Required** 



* 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years building production LLM\-powered or agentic systems — not POCs or portfolio projects, shipped and operated in production.

* Demonstrated ability to work directly with non\-technical stakeholders to scope and define a use case — this is as important as the technical skill set.
* A clear point of view on what makes an agentic system production\-ready: observability, cost control, failure handling, and a real evaluation methodology, not just a working demo.



  





**Strong plusses** 



* Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tooling: Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize, or MLflow.
* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or A2A agent\-to\-agent communication patterns.
* Background contributing to or designing reusable architecture patterns adopted across teams — you think in patterns, not just point solutions.
* Experience in a small or fast\-moving team where you helped establish practices rather than inheriting them.



  





**Additional Information** 




**Life at Assent**

 We believe that you and your family’s well being is important. As a result, we offer vacation time that increases with tenure, comprehensive benefits packages (details vary by country), life leave days and more.

They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.

* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.

 As Hansen continues to scale its commercial operations, accurate, connected data is critical to better customer and growth decisions. There is no commercial analytics capability and no central data platform in place today, so you will design the data model, the pipelines that feed it and the reporting built on top, drawing on CRM, marketing automation, finance and other commercial systems.
 



 During the first 12 months you will partner closely with IT and business stakeholders to design and implement the data infrastructure, data flows, metric definitions, reporting standards and self\-service dashboards the organisation needs. Alongside that you will own the standing commercial reporting cycle and the calculation and reporting of variable compensation outcomes against approved plans.

**Risk Consulting – Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) – Business Solutions – Manager**
**Description**
 EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry\-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker\-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process \& controls.
   

  

 Within EY’s Risk Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset\-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.
   

  

 Within FSRM, the Business Solutions team assists across end\-to\-end aspects of Capital management, CECL, BASEL, credit risk and ICAAP related activities:
   

  

* Key role involves producing critical deliverables to the senior management and regulators including EMEIA, US and APAC entities’ capital projections, Individual Capital Adequacy Assessment Process (ICAAP), capital aspects of Recovery \& Resolution planning (RRP), as well as owning the ICAAP framework and standards, and having oversight of various regulatory requirements.
* Consulting and solutions delivery such as impact assessments, defining the target operating model, and integrated risk and finance reporting framework
* Quality assurance such as assessment of controls of the Banking industry and similar business lines covering regulatory reporting involving Basel/CRR/CECL/COREP/FINREP regulations or Pillar 2 / ICAAP framework
* Early identification and accurate analysis of prudential developments and influence on changes to the capital framework.
* Regulatory capital impact assessment in legal entity simplification initiatives, business re\-organizations, new business initiatives and external commitments to regulators (especially with the PRA and ECB).


 Clients include large domestic and global financial institutions, broker\-dealers, foreign banking organizations, asset management firms with significant capital markets activities. Project teams frequently work with the senior management of these firms, including CFOs and CROs.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As part of the financial analysis of the bank’s exposures to a diverse range of public, semi‑public, and private counterparties \- including local authorities and their affiliates, public institutions, sovereigns, public financial institutions, SPVs, corporates, PPP/concession companies, and sponsors \- analysts will support credit‑risk assessments and contribute to internal‑rating activities across France and key international markets (primarily France, Italy, Spain, the UK, and, to a lesser extent, the US).

* Conduct in‑depth financial analysis, including detailed review of public‑sector and corporate financial statements (IFRS/French GAAP), ratio assessments (leverage, coverage, liquidity), evaluation of working capital requirements, and comprehensive cash‑flow analysis.

* Evaluate sovereign and quasi‑sovereign credit risk by analyzing institutional frameworks, governance quality, policy stability, and levels of explicit or implicit government support.
* Perform corporate and sectoral assessments by analyzing business models, industry dynamics, competitive positioning (utilities, transportation, energy, social infrastructure), and conducting sensitivity and benchmarking analyses across markets.
* Review and interpret financing documentation, including term sheets, loan documentation, covenant packages, guarantees, and where applicable key provisions within bond indentures.
* Build, review, and validate financial models with strong command of Excel; analyze large datasets and generate comparative insights (experience with Power BI/SQL is an advantage).

* Support and conduct gap assessments, impact analyses, and business‑readiness evaluations related to regulatory change initiatives.
* Demonstrate strong technical expertise and up‑to‑date industry knowledge across financial products, market practices, and risk methodologies.
* Lead key workstreams within large‑scale client engagements or independently manage smaller engagements, ensuring consistent delivery of high‑quality outcomes.
* Review outputs prepared by team members to ensure analytical quality, completeness, and adherence to internal standards.
* Stay informed of emerging trends, regulatory changes, and sector‑specific developments to anticipate client needs and strengthen advisory delivery.
* Monitor project progress, proactively manage risks, and communicate priorities, challenges, and updates effectively to stakeholders.
* Mentor and guide junior consultants, fostering skill development, knowledge sharing, and professional growth within the team.


**Qualifications, Certifications And Education**
**Must\-have:**
* Master’s degree in Business Administration (Finance/Economics) or CA qualification, with 7\-10 years of relevant experience in financial analysis or risk‑related roles.
* Foundational experience (internship/apprenticeship/junior role) in financial analysis, credit risk, audit, or corporate finance.

* Advanced proficiency in Excel, with foundational knowledge of Power BI and/or SQL considered a plus.

* Ability to collaborate effectively with business and technical stakeholders, including senior leadership.
* Demonstrated automation and innovation mindset, with willingness to improve processes and tools.
* Strong command of written and spoken professional English.
* Basic AI knowledge, excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly, analytical thinking, and problem solving skills.


**Good\-to\-have:**

* Regulatory exposure or experience in areas such as Credit Underwriting, Basel frameworks, and CCAR.
* Familiarity with risk‑management systems, tools, or platforms.

* Advanced knowledge in AI is good to have.

title: Associate IT Systems Engineer
description:
**Job Posting Title**
 Associate IT Systems Engineer
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
 The Cloud FinOps Engineer is responsible for optimizing cloud financial management practices across enterprise cloud platforms including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). This role serves as the bridge between Finance, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure, and Application teams to ensure cloud resources are cost\-effective, properly governed, accurately allocated, and aligned with business objectives.
   

  

 The Cloud FinOps Engineer provides financial visibility into cloud spending, develops cost optimization strategies, supports budgeting and forecasting activities, and drives accountability through chargeback/showback reporting. The role is instrumental in establishing a culture of cost awareness while enabling innovation and business growth through efficient cloud adoption.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Cloud Financial Management**
* Monitor and analyze cloud spending across AWS, Azure, and OCI environments.
* Develop and maintain cloud cost allocation, chargeback, and showback models.
* Prepare monthly cloud financial reports, variance analyses, and executive dashboards.
* Support annual budget planning and ongoing cloud spend forecasting.
* Track cloud consumption trends and identify opportunities for cost reduction.


**Cost Optimization**
* Identify underutilized, idle, or oversized cloud resources.
* Recommend and implement optimization initiatives including:
+ Rightsizing computing resources
+ Storage lifecycle optimization
+ Resource scheduling and automation
+ Reserved capacity and savings plans
+ Backup and retention optimization

* Quantify financial impact and realized savings from optimization initiatives.
* Track and report cost savings achieved through FinOps programs.


**Service \& Operational Support**
* Monitor and manage the Cloud Infrastructure service requests.
* Triage, prioritize, and coordinate resolution of cloud\-related incidents, requests, and operational issues.
* Work with Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure, Application, Security, and vendor teams to ensure timely ticket resolution.
* Provide cost analysis and financial impact assessments for cloud service requests, upgrades, and infrastructure changes.
* Track recurring support trends and identify opportunities for automation, optimization, and service improvement.
* Maintain documentation, knowledge articles, and standard operating procedures related to cloud financial operations and cloud service delivery.
* Ensure cloud service requests comply with established governance, budgeting, tagging, and cost allocation standards.


**Governance \& Compliance**
* Develop and enforce cloud tagging and cost attribution standards.
* Partner with cloud platform teams to ensure financial accountability of cloud resources.
* Support Cloud Governance and Cloud Operating Model initiatives.
* Assist in establishing policies, guardrails, and reporting standards related to cloud financial management.


**Reporting \& Analytics**
* Build dashboards and reports using Power BI, Excel, Cloud Health, native cloud tools, or equivalent platforms.
* Analyze cost drivers, trends, business consumption patterns, and forecasting models.
* Produce cloud KPI and FinOps metrics including:
+ Cost per application
+ Cost per business unit
+ Budget versus actual spending
+ Optimization savings realized


**Business Partnership**
* Collaborate with Finance teams during planning, budgeting, and forecasting cycles.
* Advise application owners and business stakeholders on cloud cost implications.
* Support business cases and total cost of ownership (TCO) analysis for cloud projects.
* Provide cost estimates for new cloud deployments, cloud migrations, and infrastructure modifications.


**Process Improvement \& Automation**
* Automate reporting and cost data collection processes.
* Improve cost visibility through tagging, dashboards, and self\-service reporting.
* Support continuous improvement of the organization's FinOps maturity and Cloud Operating Model.
* Develop scripts, reports, and automation workflows to improve operational efficiency and cloud cost transparency.


 All other duties as assigned.
   

  

**Required Skills And Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, or related field preferred.
* 2\+ years of experience in cloud platforms, cloud operations, financial analysis, infrastructure operations, or FinOps.
* Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, and/or OCI cost management tools.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Experience developing reports and dashboards using Power BI or similar tools.
* Understanding of cloud infrastructure services, including compute, storage, networking, databases, backup, and disaster recovery.
* Experience working with IT service management platforms such as ServiceNow, Freshservice, or equivalent ticketing systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

The company is headquartered in Detroit, MI, with operations that span 24 countries and more than 175 locations. Formed through the acquisition of Dowlais Group plc and its subsidiaries \- GKN Automotive and GKN Powder Metallurgy, Dauch unites deep engineering roots with global manufacturing capabilities and an entrepreneurial spirit to move mobility forward.  Economic Value (EV) and Net Interest Income (NII) risk management, support Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP) and

* residential mortgage modelling: Integrate, maintain and calibrate our prepayment models based on ADCO loan dynamics suite. Develop, integrate and enhance our OAS modelling framework combining term structure modelling with the prepayment models to ensure convexity and path dependent outcomes are captured for optimal hedging strategies. Develop a mortgage pipe\-line pull\-through model;
* advance risk metrics and hedging strategies for convexity risk management;
* commercial Real Estate (CRE) modelling: develop and maintain US CRE mortgage prepayment model and integrate into the OAS valuation engine and NII interest rate risk platforms;
* NMD replication modelling: develop and maintain non\-maturing deposit replication models. Build and calibrate replicating portfolio (RPF) strategies that convert depositor behavior into fixed cash\-flow ladders to capture behavioral duration profiles. Develop and advance deposit rate modelling (DRM) and volume/attrition modelling, and incorporate their outputs to replication strategies and NII projections;
* EVS/NII and FTP integration: support alignment of model methodologies with margin\-stripped EVS policies. Integrate model outputs into our EVS/NII risk management and FTP frameworks;
* tooling and productionization: build robust, well\-tested Python/C\+\+ libraries and prototypes. Partner with technology teams to deploy these models into production risk engines and P\&L tools used by ALM Strategy and Structural Rates Trading;
* model governance: document model assumptions, methodologies, and controls in line with UBS model risk standards. Regularly recalibrate and test models, and support material model changes through established governance processes;
* cross\-functional collaboration: work closely with colleagues in Trading, Risk, Finance, Model Validation, and Technology. Present analysis in governance forums and respond to regulatory or audit queries with clarity and rigor.

Our U.S. team works closely with counterparts in Switzerland to meet both regional and global requirements.

* Preferred experience with deposit rate modelling (DRM), attrition modelling, and replication modelling. Familiarity with EVS/NII, FTP, and margin\-stripping practices. Exposure to OCC, FDIC, or BCBS IRRBB regulatory guidelines.
* Quantitative skills: proven ability to apply numerical analysis, statistics, and financial mathematics to design, validate, and maintain risk management models.
* Technical skills: proficiency in Python, C\+\+, SQL, and MS Office. Experience with time\-series analysis, survival/ hazard modelling, regime\-switching or state\-space models, Monte Carlo simulation, optimization, and back testing. Strong documentation skills.
* Collaboration: ability to work effectively with colleagues in Trading, Risk, Technology, Finance, and Model Validation. Team player with a can\-do attitude, comfortable working in an international team environment.
* Mindset: comfortable with change. Proactive, structured, and committed to high\-quality model development and governance.

title: Lead Full Stack Developer (.NET & Angular)
description:
Lead Full Stack Developer — AI\-Forward Development (.NET \& Angular)
 



  





 Saisystems Health is hiring a Lead Full Stack Developer with 9\+ years of .NET and Angular experience, a US healthcare background and a track record of AI\-forward engineering to lead technical delivery on ECM, our enterprise claims management platform.
 



  





 About the role
 



  





 The Lead owns technical direction and delivery quality for an ECM squad: setting architecture and coding standards, reviewing critical changes, mentoring developers, and still shipping hands\-on code across Angular, .NET and T\-SQL. Roughly half the role is hands\-on engineering; the rest is design, review, planning and people leadership.
 



  





**The product.** 
 ECM manages the full claim lifecycle for US healthcare provider organisations: patient and encounter capture, coding and charge entry, eligibility, a configurable business\-rules engine, clearinghouse claim transmission, ERA/835 payment posting, denial and AR work queues, patient statements, credentialing and executive reporting.
 



  





**The engineering problem.** 
 ECM is a mature, high\-volume, multi\-tenant SaaS platform with tens of millions of claim and transaction rows, external BI consumers on the same database, and scheduled automation alongside the API. The Lead decides how new features and modernisation — performance, observability, test coverage, security hardening and debt reduction — are sequenced in a system that cannot stop running.
 



  





**Why AI\-forward.** 
 The Lead sets how the team uses AI: which tools and workflows are approved, how AI\-assisted code is reviewed, and where AI measurably improves throughput and quality — while keeping PHI and secrets out of external tools.
 



  





 Key responsibilities
 



  





 Technical leadership and architecture
 


* Own the technical design of features and modernisation work across Angular, ASP.NET Core and Azure SQL; write design notes and lead design reviews.
* Define and enforce coding standards, layering (controller → interface → service → stored procedure), API contracts and Angular/NgRx patterns.
* Lead decomposition of oversized services and components, and plan incremental refactoring without disrupting production.
* Drive database performance: indexing strategy, execution\-plan analysis, Query Store regressions and locking against concurrent BI reads.
* Shape the architecture of healthcare integrations — X12 EDI (837, 835, 277CA, 999\), clearinghouse SFTP, ERA auto\-posting and payer interfaces.



  





 AI\-forward engineering leadership
 


* Set the team's AI development practice: approved tools, prompting and context\-management techniques, and agentic workflows for multi\-file changes, test generation and migration.
* Define review standards for AI\-assisted code, with added scrutiny for stored procedures, EDI processing and production data paths.
* Identify, prototype and measure AI use cases in the workflow and the product (for example, test\-case design, code review assistance, denial analysis or document extraction) within approved, HIPAA\-compliant tooling.
* Coach developers on effective, verified AI use and share reusable prompts and playbooks across teams.



  





 Delivery and quality
 


* Break down epics into estimable work with the Development Manager and product owners; own sprint technical commitments.
* Review pull requests on critical paths and run pre\-merge impact assessment across develop → QA → UAT → staging → production.
* Raise unit and integration test coverage (xUnit, Moq, Jasmine/Karma) and partner with QA on regression strategy.
* Lead diagnosis of production incidents using Application Insights, logs and Query Store; run root\-cause reviews and track fixes.
* Maintain a prioritised technical\-debt backlog and balance it against feature delivery.



  





 People and collaboration
 


* Mentor and grow developers through pairing, code review and design feedback; contribute to hiring and onboarding.
* Act as the technical point of contact for US\-based product and business stakeholders, translating requirements into clear designs and realistic estimates.
* Communicate status, risks and trade\-offs clearly in writing for asynchronous, cross\-time\-zone work.



  





 Security and compliance
 


* Ensure HIPAA and secure\-by\-default practices are designed in: minimum\-necessary data access, audit logging, secrets in Key Vault, least\-privilege access and no PHI in logs, tickets or AI tools.
* Review designs for audit, access\-control and data\-retention requirements.



  





 Required qualifications
 



  





 Experience
 


* 9\+ years of professional software development, with deep full stack experience in .NET and Angular on production systems.
* 3\+ years in a technical lead, tech lead or senior\-lead role — owning design, code review and delivery for a team of developers.
* 3\+ years working on US healthcare software — revenue cycle management, medical billing, claims, practice management, EHR or payer systems.



  





 .NET, database and architecture
 


* Expert C\# and ASP.NET Core Web API (.NET 6 or later), with EF Core and/or Dapper; strong grasp of layered architecture, SOLID and dependency injection.
* Advanced SQL Server / T\-SQL: designing schemas and indexes, tuning complex stored procedures, reading execution plans and resolving locking and blocking at scale.
* Proven experience refactoring and modernising a large, live codebase incrementally.



  





 Angular
 


* Expert Angular (12\+) with TypeScript, RxJS and NgRx or another Redux\-style store; able to set front\-end architecture and standards for a team.



  





 AI\-forward engineering
 


* Demonstrated daily use of AI development platforms — Claude / Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT / Codex, Cursor or similar — including agentic workflows on a large codebase.
* Experience introducing or standardising AI tooling for a team, with clear review and verification practices.
* Can show examples of measurable gains (throughput, test coverage, defect reduction) from AI\-assisted work, and of catching flawed AI output.



  





 Healthcare domain
 


* Strong knowledge of the claim lifecycle: charge entry, claim submission, adjudication, remittance, denials and AR follow\-up.
* Hands\-on experience with HIPAA X12 transactions (837, 835, 277CA, 999\) and CMS\-1500 / UB\-04 claim formats.
* Working understanding of the HIPAA Priv



  





 Leadership and practice
 


* Git, pull\-request workflow and CI/CD on Azure DevOps or similar; experience defining branching and release processes.
* Track record of mentoring developers and leading design and code reviews.
* Clear written and verbal communication with US\-based stakeholders.
* Willing to work from the Pune office full time.



  





 Preferred qualifications
 


* Experience integrating LLM APIs (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenAI) into .NET applications — prompt design, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), structured output, evaluation and cost control — within HIPAA\-compliant boundaries.
* Experience shipping AI features in RCM, such as denial prediction, coding assistance, document extraction or claim scrubbing.
* Deep Microsoft Azure experience: App Service, WebJobs, Blob Storage, Key Vault, Service Bus, Redis, Application Insights, Entra ID; infrastructure\-as\-code (Bicep or Terraform).
* Multi\-tenant SaaS architecture, message\-driven design and background\-job orchestration.
* EDI tooling such as EdiFabric; clearinghouse onboarding and payer connectivity.
* Observability practice: structured logging (Serilog), distributed tracing, SLOs and alerting.
* Reporting or BI exposure (Power BI, SSRS) and designing for concurrent BI workloads.
* Certifications (any of): Azure Developer Associate (AZ\-204\), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\), Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI\-102\), or healthcare coursework such as AAPC or HFMA.



  





**Education:** 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field — or equivalent demonstrable professional experience. What you have built, shipped and led counts more than the credential.
 



  





 Core competencies and success measures
 



  





 Leadership competencies
 


* **Technical judgement** 
 — makes sound trade\-offs between speed, quality and risk in a live, regulated system.
* **Evidence over assertion** 
 — backs decisions on performance and impact with measurements.
* **Production respect** 
 — weighs every change for its effect on live claims, payments and data.
* **Multiplier mindset** 
 — raises the team's output through mentoring, standards and shared AI practice, not just personal output.
* **Clear written communication** 
 — design notes, status and risk updates that work across time zones.



  





 Compliance, security and responsible AI use
 



  




* ECM processes Protected Health Information (PHI). All engineers complete HIPAA training and are bound by Saisystems Health security and confidentiality policies.
* The Lead is accountable for the team following these rules and for raising compliance risks early.
* No PHI, patient data, credentials, production connection strings or confidential business data is ever entered into an external or unapproved AI tool.
* AI is an accelerator, not a substitute for engineering judgement; accountability for correctness stays with the engineer and the reviewing Lead.
* AI\-generated code is reviewed to the same standard as hand\-written code, with added scrutiny for stored procedures, EDI processing and production data paths.
* Secure\-by\-default habits: no PHI in logs, tickets, screenshots or non\-production data; least\-privilege access; secrets in Key Vault, never in source.
* Employment is subject to a background check and a signed confidentiality agreement.



  





**Equal opportunity:** 
 Saisystems Health is an equal opportunity employer.
